prompt: Generate a vertical 9:16 security-camera frame from a cheap ceiling-corner CCTV camera in a small British convenience store after midnight. Grey-green infrared monochrome, fisheye distortion bending the shelf rows, blown-out highlights, video noise and a faint horizontal rolling band. A white timestamp in a blocky digital font in the top corner reads "03:12:47". In the empty aisle below, a shelf-edge label under a single loaf of plain white bread reads "50p", legible in the glare; beside it an unbranded small purple chocolate bar with a plain wrapper, labelled "10p". The far end of the aisle smears into a soft dark blur, as if something is standing too close to the lens. Shop completely deserted. Thanks.
